title: The Listening Portrait
author: Freya Galloway
blurb: Felix Galloway, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
